Sources

Weierstrass data reproduced numerically against the shipped implementation (math_art/minsurf/zoo.py, row RICHMOND_K) by sampling g and dh over rings in the complex plane at the row's default parameters: g: matches over 144 complex samples (worst 0); dh: matches over 144 complex samples (worst 0).

  • R. Schoen / Lopez & Ros (1991) on the Lopez-Ros deformation; H. F. Scherk (1835) for the base Scherk surface; the decorated-Enneper symmetrization follows M. Weber's repository, https://minimalsurfaces.blog/ (Enneper with n Catenoids).
